title: Force Group Policy Updates and Domain Authentication Validation

purpose.text: Automated workflow to force Group Policy updates, generate diagnostic reports if needed, and validate Active Directory secure channel relationships.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to force Group Policy updates, generate diagnostic reports if needed, and validat

scope.text: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Force Group Policy Updates and Domain Authentication Validation

steps.action: Force a comprehensive download of all user and computer group policies from the Domain Controller.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Computer Policy update has completed successfully' AND 'User Policy update has completed successfully', set variables.policy_update_success = true, else set variables.policy_update_success = false
steps.quote: Trigger a comprehensive download of all user and computer group policies from the Domain Controller

steps.action: Generate a detailed HTML diagnostic report of active policy configurations if the initial policy update fails.
steps.quote: If policies fail to reflect, generate a detailed diagnostic report to check what security groups and GPOs are being blocked

steps.action: Validate the machine's local trust account authentication against the domain server using nltest.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Access Denied' or 'RPC failure', set variables.secure_channel_broken = true, else set variables.secure_channel_broken = false
steps.quote: Verify if the machine's local trust account is properly authenticated against the domain server
